_about: Catalogue of grandstand modules: a kit of traditional stand sections at one scale, snapping together along a shared front line. Read by the course layout tool (footprints) and, next, by tools/blender/build_stand_modules.py (geometry, using tools/blender/kit.py). Metres. Every module is a whole number of 3.5 m bays long, sits on the same 3.0 m podium with 3.5 m storeys, and has its front face on the shared front line (local z = 0, depth runs back). Left and right are as seen from the track. 'ends' says how each end meets its neighbour: 'party' = shared wall, hidden by the next module; 'finished' = a dressed end elevation (only end pavilions); 'stepped' = the tiers step down so a lower neighbour reads cleanly. Sources: S1 = reference/architecture/victorian-grandstand-sheet.png (the stand already built), S2 = reference/architecture/victorian-grandstand-sheet-300m.png.
